doc.title: Rudy Van Gelder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

title: Thanks from the Smithsonian and closing of the interview
summary: Ken Kimery thanks Rudy and the interview ends.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well I just want to say on behalf of the Smithsonian Institution and as an agent, somewhat agent for the NEA for the Smithsonian, we really, really appreciate and thank you for letting us come into your studio, your home, and document you for the historic record here. This is something that will be available for generations to come.
Thank you. I appreciate the opportunity to get some things straightened out.
That’s what we are here to do, straighten it out. If there is anything you want to straighten out after this, just let me know. We will continue to straighten it out.
‘Cause we’re the forever business. We’re going to straighten those things out.
I like that, that’s nice. (Laughs) That’s great. I am too you know.
You are too, that’s absolutely correct. ### END OF INTERVIEW Transcribed by Kyle Kelly-Yahner
